subject: Cross object with map information only?

messages.author: fb4d09b984b22d87
messages.subject: Cross object with map information only?
parts:
Dear Karl,

I would like to use some plotting functions for genetic maps, either from the qtl package (plot.map),  or from pheno2geno (plotMapComparison), for comparison of two genetic maps. I only have the genetic map data, but no genotypes or phenotypes. Is there a way to generate a cross object with map information only or any other way to use these plotting functions?

Best regards,
Eva

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Cross object with map information only?
parts:
There is a "map" object, which is a list, with each component being a vector of marker positions for a given chromosome.

Take a look at the map10 data included with R/qtl:

library(qtl)
data(map10)

If you read in your map as a table with chromosome and position (and with marker names as row names), you'd want to do the reverse of the function map2table().

maptab <- map2table(map10)

I'd do:

map <- split(maptab$pos, maptab$chr)
mar <- split(rownames(maptab), maptab$chr)
for(i in seq(along=map))
names(map[[i]]) <- mar[[i]]

You might want to add "map" class; some functions are insistent on that.

class(map) <- "map"

karl
